comments.text: Read $0E and wait until it changes, then return. The story interrupt handler at $17D7 increments this byte.

If CIA1 port A bit 4 is low, return $80. Otherwise test 30 row and column pattern pairs from $1724 and $1742: write a row to port A, compare port B with the corresponding value, and on a match wait for that value to change before returning its index. Return $FF when none matches.
Thirty values written to CIA1 port A by the input scanner at $16F2; each entry is paired with a port B value at $1742.
Thirty port B values compared by the input scanner at $16F2, paired by index with the row values at $1724.
Disable interrupts, schedule the handler at $17D7 for raster $20, enable the VIC interrupt, clear bit 7 of $D011, then re-enable interrupts and return.

Disable interrupts, write $36 to the processor port, set the KERNAL IRQ vector to $17A1 and the raster compare to $20, acknowledge and enable the VIC interrupt, clear bit 7 of $D011 and write zero to CIA1 control A before returning.

Call the interrupt helper, set border and background black, select video bank 1 and VIC memory and display settings, increment $0E, then call the helper at $1907 with X=$05, Y=$18 and A=$7A before jumping to $191D.
Call $1916 and set border and background black. When $145D is nonzero, change VIC display and bank settings and enable the sprites; then pass X=$58, Y=$18 and A=$AA to $1907 and jump to $191D.
Call $1916, delay with twelve NOPs, write $18 then $78 to $D011, and set the VIC bank and memory and display registers. Pass X=$8C, Y=$18 and A=$B0 to $1907, then jump to $191D.
Call $1916 and combine $78 with $1903 for $D011. If $1903 is nonzero, pass $18B4 and raster value $B8 to $1907; otherwise pass $18DC and $B7. Both paths jump to $191D.
Call $1916, delay with nine NOPs and combine $10 with $1903 for $D011. If $145E is nonzero call the sound update at $E13A; pass $17D7 and raster value $20 to $1907, then jump to $191D.

Alternate handler selected by $188C when $1903 is zero. Call $1916, delay with three NOPs and a countdown from X=5, then set $D011 from $10 OR $1903. If $145E is nonzero call $E13A; pass $17D7 and raster value $20 to $1907 and jump to $191D.
Write X and Y as the low and high bytes of the next hardware IRQ vector, write A to the raster compare register $D012, acknowledge the raster interrupt, and return.
Save A, X and Y in zero-page bytes $02, $03 and $04, respectively.
Restore A, X and Y from zero-page bytes $02–$04 and return from the interrupt with RTI.
Wait for $0E to change, then test CIA1 port A bit 4. If it is low, return; otherwise scan input with $16F2, save the result at $19A3 and repeat while the result is $FF.
